description: This file is a makefile fragment for configuring and building the Linux kernel within the OpenWrt build system. It includes definitions for preparing kernel sources, setting up initramfs, copying kernel images, and cleaning build artifacts, with conditional logic based on configuration options.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the kernel source, either by extracting from a tarball or linking to an external kernel tree based on configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, modifying .config based on whether initramfs is separate or external.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the kernel configuration for initramfs, including compression options and root permissions.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel build, copying kernel settings, and generating the final .config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures the kernel for initramfs using the SetInitramfs function.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules and saves the configuration state.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies the built kernel image and related files to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and copies it to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/PrepareConfigPerRootfs
methods.description: Prepares a separate kernel configuration directory per root filesystem.
